Fort Charlotte
pois.description: Built in 1788 by Lord Dunmore, the fort was named after the wife of King George III, Queen Saharia Charlotte. The fort has a moat, dungeons, underground passageways, and 42 cannons, which have never been fired in an act of aggression.

terminalResolution.notes: Ships berth at Prince George Wharf (Nassau Cruise Port) downtown. The Google terminal result is the same wharf; 'Port of Nassau' is east near Potter's Cay; the rest are a shop and Paradise Island ferries.
